scope.description: Issue #278 combined capability-suite manifest, ordinary case-by-harness expansion, EvalService selection/persistence/reopen, dashboard selection, native recursion ownership, and outcome/presentation gating.
exclusions: Production Delivery Planner sources were changing during review.
Excalidraw scene-history sources were changing during review.

checkpoints.assertion: The harness host exposes complete(inputGraph) through provider adapters and owns no recursive queue or scheduler; Codex and Prime retain native recursive execution.
EvalService.open preserves terminal persisted grades and absent terminal legacy grades; it settles only judge evidence belonging to executions observed queued/running before normalization.

The code-owned manifest pins ordered membership and grading identities, fails closed on drift, expands through the ordinary case-by-harness matrix, and copies the full suite identity to run and execution records.
Catalog projection marks a suite unavailable when any member is unavailable; createRun rejects unavailable membership and caller member overrides before queueing.
Task outcome uses deterministic checks and mandatory outcome gates. Presentation is recorded separately and does not compensate for a failed outcome.
A real createRun-to-disk-to-open regression preserves the exact ordered ten case IDs and suite identity; interrupted recovery preserves historical evidence boundaries.
The real web host renders suite availability, selects the suite’s ten members for inspection, submits the suite ID, clears suite selection for an ordinary manual case, and shows unavailable reasons.
